instruction: Set up a plain text signature for my Thunderbird email with three lines: "Dr. Smith", "Senior Researcher", and "Global Science Institute".

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened Thunderbird Account Settings, navigated to identity section, typed a 2-line plain text signature, and completed the task in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Account Settings in Thunderbird, navigate identity settings panel, edit text fields (signature, organization, name), type multi-line text
metadata.task_rationale: Harder variation of the original signature task — requires 3 lines instead of 2, testing the model's ability to handle longer multi-line input in the same field.
metadata.explanation: Task requires setting a 3-line plain text signature in Thunderbird. Evaluator checks mail.identity.id1.htmlSigText in prefs.js matches 'Dr. Smith\nSenior Researcher\nGlobal Science Institute' via regex.

scoring_breakdown.signature_content: 1.0 - All three lines present in correct order

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches prefs.js from the Thunderbird profile directory on the VM
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js line by line, extracts key-value pairs via json.loads, and matches against rules using _match_value_to_rule

Regex pattern 'Dr\.\s*Smith\nSenior Researcher\nGlobal Science Institute' with re.S flag correctly matches the expected 3-line signature content after json.loads converts escaped newlines to real newlines
Expected parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses rule.get('expect', {}) — consistent with the framework's type='rule' behavior

Minor coverage gap: evaluator checks signature content but does not verify mail.identity.id1.htmlSigFormat is false (plain text mode). If the same text were set as an HTML signature, the evaluator would still pass, despite the instruction specifying 'plain text signature'
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add an additional expect rule for 'mail.identity.id1.htmlSigFormat' with method 'eq' and ref false to verify the signature is set as plain text, not HTML

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
